decisions.briefing: Markets dipped slightly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, which counts as a neutral day rather than a sell-off. The portfolio is up about 50% overall. We have $646 in cash and 3 open slots, so we are adding one medium-conviction position in RH, which passed all four of our buy checks. We are keeping all current holdings and letting the stop-losses and profit targets do their job.

market_education.summary_en: Major indexes slipped slightly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, so tech stocks fell a bit more than the broader market. A drop this small looks like routine profit-taking and position adjustments, not a real shift in investor mood. No news headlines were provided today, so we can't link the move to a specific event.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日小幅回落，納斯達克指數下跌0.6%，標普500指數則微跌0.3%，科技股跌幅略大於大市。如此輕微的跌幅，看來只是一般的獲利回吐和倉位調整，並非市場情緒出現實質轉向。由於今日未有提供相關新聞標題，暫時無法將走勢歸因於特定事件。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Confirmation signals means waiting for several separate indicators to point the same way before you buy, instead of acting on just one. Today RH had four at once: a MACD crossover, a healthy RSI, a price above its 20-day average, and unusually high trading volume. When all of these line up, it suggests large investors are really buying, not that the price just jumped at random.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「多重訊號確認」是指在買入前，先等待多個獨立指標同時指向同一方向，而非單憑一個訊號便貿然入市。今日RH同時出現四個訊號：MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於健康區間、股價企穩20日均線之上，以及成交量明顯放大。當這些訊號同時出現，通常代表有大型投資者真正入場，而非股價隨機的短暫跳升。
